title: Scotland managers in order
brief: Name Scotland's ten permanent managers from Andy Roxburgh (1986) to Steve Clarke, in order. Each place is labelled with the year he took charge; Alex McLeish had two spells and fills two places. Caretakers (Tommy Burns, Billy Stark, Malky Mackay) don't count.

notes.Alex Ferguson: Alex Ferguson was interim manager in 1985 and 1986, before Roxburgh.
notes.Jock Stein: Jock Stein (1978 to 1985) was before this period.
notes.Billy Stark: Billy Stark was caretaker in 2012 and 2013.
notes.Malky Mackay: Malky Mackay was caretaker in 2017 and 2018.
notes.Sebastien Pocognoli: Sebastien Pocognoli was appointed in August 2026, after this period.
notes.Steve Clarke: Steve Clarke resigned after the 2026 World Cup.

checks: Wikipedia's managers list and Transfermarkt's staff history agree on the order and start dates: Roxburgh July 1986, Brown November 1993, Vogts February 2002, Smith December 2004, McLeish January 2007, Burley January 2008, Levein December 2009, Strachan January 2013, McLeish February 2018, Clarke May 2019 to June 2026. Ten from Roxburgh fits exactly, ending with Clarke, who left after the 2026 World Cup; his successor started in August 2026.
